title: Independent verification: helper470 native replay and full-frame closure cost (no new kappa)
body:
Ross Richardson's PR1256 leaves native multi-stage replay of its helper470 retirement circuit open. This package independently reconstructs the exact frozen patch and runs the unchanged record-geometry and five/nine/eleven-stage F2 scalar engines. All pass. It also prices the missing full-frame closure: that MOVE removes the rank-mass saving, and the resulting raw child moment is strictly worse than the baseline for every `0<a<1` under the same allocation and fixed remaining charges.

**Status: independent finite verification and scoped endpoint result; no new kappa or selected supplier adoption.** Literal H4 remains false for both modified words. A passing staged scalar receipt does not establish reverse projector routing, actual owner/window hosting or all-size multiplication.

Only `research/bit-helper470-native/` and its dedicated native workflow are added. The selected frontier, frozen inputs and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Validation:

- Three complete words: PR589 baseline, PR1256 rank-seven endpoint, and its full-frame closure. All 661 dirty local columns and native 883/1327/1549 staged columns checked; every ADD/MOVE/COPY charge recounted.
- Eight on-disk native fault controls and 144 omitted-bridge controls reject. Four frame/price faults still pass scalar columns, explicitly distinguishing the coverage.
- Full conservative prefix bounds remain F=49347/B=1113070, local93/nine177 bits under strict104/192 charges. Complete deterministic certificate matches on Python3.14.5 and isolated optimized Python3.12.14.
- Registered Python3.12 replay and eight package tests pass; 25 selected-input tests, nine finite-bit-contract tests and twenty research-workflow tests pass. YAML and staged whitespace checks pass. Linux/hosted CI is separate; no remote pass is claimed.

Reproduce:

```sh
BOOST_INCLUDE=/path/containing/boost python3 -I -B research/bit-helper470-native/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_HELPER470_NATIVE stages=5,9,11 words=3 retired_mass=5128 closed_mass=5129 H4_open no_new_kappa`.

Base `bdd4c63ac7c5d8a46ce070ba133df8d7ba9cb92c`; PR1256 `d6d5a994fcdcd8d04ec439ff988daa8f37b17ece`. OS assignment seed12, bit-supplier track. Source Git/SHA256 pins, scope change, three candidates, stopping rule, full bills and open next questions are included. Final overlap refresh covered 794 open PRs and 45 discussions; refreshed main `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f` retains all fourteen live inputs and the same selected record.

Credit Ross Richardson/PR1256 for the circuit and explicit follow-up; Ali Romman/PR1128 and PR1043, Sagar Thakrar/PR1023, Adam Gall/PR1179, PR589/555/543 and the preserved native/geometry lineage. PR1043's distinct helper deletion remains a predecessor, not an improvement claimed here; PR1271 investigates other B cuts. Prepared by Sricharan Vagvala (@theon199) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.
